# Aging proteomics repository

> Search and quantification results for 163 public proteomics datasets, reanalysed with one pipeline into one schema, for questions about how organelle proteomes change with age. Every number here comes from catalog `763737672ff569ca` (datarepo 1.3.2, schema 0.0.15, built 2026-10-17T11:23:45+00:00); cite that id with any number you reuse.

Before you answer from this data:

- Counts at 1% FDR come from the `*_1pct` views (`psms_1pct`, `peptidoforms_1pct`, `protein_groups_1pct`). The base tables also hold decoys and sub-threshold matches.
- Each dataset page lists its open findings. A `low_id_rate` or `sdrf_skeleton` finding means the absence of a protein, or of sample metadata, is weak evidence.
- An empty table means nothing was delivered. It does not mean the answer is zero or none. The MCP `describe` tool says which tables are empty.
- Contaminant proteins (e.g. bovine albumin, porcine trypsin) are flagged and carry their own species. They are reagents, not evidence about the sample's organism. The flag is PER DATASET: human albumin is a target in a human search and a contaminant in a rodent one.
- A dataset's organism is the organism of the protein database searched, not a statement about the samples.
- `pep` values are not comparable across datasets: the model is retrained on every search. Compare counts at a threshold instead.
- A protein group's accession list is kept in the search engine's order, and MetaMorpheus writes it alphabetically. The first accession is not a leading or razor protein, and nothing in this repository names one.

## Datasets

- [PXD001054: Redox Proteome of Skeletal Muscle](datasets/PXD001054.html): PXD001054 is a DDA label-free dataset (Mus musculus) with 9 runs, 9 samples and no enrichment step (whole proteome). It was reanalysed with MetaMorpheus 1.1.11. At 1% FDR the search reports 45,259 PSMs, 6,875 peptidoforms and 844 protein groups, and the repository holds 2,809 PTM sites for it. 4 open warnings about it are recorded.

## Access

- [datasets.json](datasets.json): a small index, one entry per dataset, each naming its full JSON (`datasets/<id>.json`: every fact on its page, all findings and modifications).
- [proteins/index.json](proteins/index.json): which datasets have accepted evidence for a protein. It lists every protein shard by accession prefix: fetch the shard whose prefix is the longest one the accession starts with. A gene symbol is in `genes/<first letter>.json`, which gives its accessions.
- [MCP server](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/dataRepo/blob/master/docs/mcp.md): `datarepo mcp --catalog <catalog.duckdb>` serves a catalog to an agent over stdio (describe, search, read-only SQL).
- [Schema](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/dataRepo/tree/master/docs/schema): every table and column, with its meaning.
- Bulk Parquet download: not published yet.

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/dataRepo): the ingester and catalog builder that made this data.
- [Limitations](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/dataRepo/blob/master/docs/limitations.md): what the repository does not yet hold.
